finding: Exact-commit workflow-run evidence depends on a time-bounded upstream query contract. GitHub's current REST documentation states that head_sha-filtered workflow-run searches are capped at 1000 results, support per_page up to 100, require Actions read permission for private repositories, and currently show X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10 in request examples. Retained commands therefore need an explicit API version, primary-source check date, maximal page size, all-page pagination intent, and no event/status/branch narrowing.

supports: gh api pagination and slurp command semantics

verification.method: node --test in isolated runtime before commit

uncertainty: The contract does not prove authentication succeeded.
The contract does not prove all pages were actually retrieved.
The contract does not remove GitHub's documented 1000-result filtered-search ceiling.
The contract does not prove workflow, deployment, runtime, audio, or human-observation outcomes.
falsification_route: Change any retained command to omit pagination, use a stale or mismatched API version, reduce per_page, or add an event/status/branch filter; the contract must fail closed. Recheck official GitHub documentation within 30 days or whenever GitHub changes the documented API version or endpoint semantics.
